title: Reject an export with six planted defects

cases.says: a clean export is accepted, and its text cells become the practice snapshot's numbers, flags and ids
an export with six planted defects is rejected: the four cell defects first, then, once they are fixed, the two the cross-project rules find
a row with two bad cells reports both
a bad amount in the second year of a cost profile is found
a window whose last start leaves no room for the second year of work is empty
two projects that are each other's parent are one cycle, reported once
an optional child whose parent cannot start early enough still leaves a plan, so it only warns
the same problem on a must-do child proves there is no plan, so it blocks
a must-do that may start late spends nothing in an early year, so a small early budget is not an error
a budget row whose year is not a number is named by that text, and the year it was meant for is reported missing
a cost cell with a bad amount still has its length checked against the window
a cost cell with two bad amounts is one finding, not two

origin.section: Rules Across Projects Run Only on Clean Cells
